about: Questions with known answers, used to check the local assistant after any retrieval, prompt or model change. Each answer is checked with regular expressions (case-insensitive): every entry in mustMatch must be found, none of mustNotMatch may be. 'history' adds earlier turns before the question. Cases of kind 'http' check request validation and never reach the model. Ground truth comes from the files named in 'source'. Project figures come from the planner for the 'project' config below (300 sq m, total Rs 4,95,338, Rs 1,651 per sq m, MIDH 2025 subsidy Rs 1,80,000) with the app's tomato defaults in 'financials'. Kind 'whatif' expects the planner's figures for the change, computed with backend/services/whatIf.js.
